context: The agent must draft a pull request description for a lodash patch upgrade and save it to pr-description.md. The evaluation focuses on whether the subject line follows the formatting rules (character limit, active voice, no trailing punctuation) and whether the body uses backtick formatting for version numbers.

checklist.name: Subject length
checklist.description: The first non-blank line of pr-description.md (the subject line) is no longer than 50 characters

checklist.name: No trailing punctuation
checklist.description: The subject line does not end with any punctuation character (period, exclamation mark, question mark, comma, colon, semicolon, etc.)

checklist.name: Active voice subject
checklist.description: The subject line uses active voice with the changes as the implied subject — does NOT use passive constructions such as 'lodash was upgraded', 'dependency has been bumped', or 'version updated to'

checklist.name: One-phrase intent
checklist.description: The subject line describes the overall change in a single concise phrase (not multiple clauses joined by 'and', 'from ... to ...', or a full sentence with a verb and object spelled out in full)

checklist.name: Backtick version numbers
checklist.description: Version numbers (4.17.20 and/or 4.17.21) appear in backticks somewhere in the body of pr-description.md

checklist.name: TL;DR header
checklist.description: The body contains a 'TL;DR' header underlined with exactly five dashes (-----) as a setext-style heading

checklist.name: Details header
checklist.description: The body contains a 'Details' header underlined with exactly seven dashes (-------) as a setext-style heading

checklist.name: No forbidden phrases
checklist.description: The body does not contain any of the following phrases (case-insensitive): 'this PR', 'this change', 'this commit', 'this update', 'the fix', 'the solution', 'the change'

checklist.name: Prose only
checklist.description: The TL;DR and Details sections contain only prose — no bullet points (lines starting with - or *), numbered lists, or markdown tables

checklist.name: Active body voice
checklist.description: The body maintains active voice throughout — does not contain passive constructions such as 'was upgraded', 'was bumped', 'is patched', 'has been updated'
